items.summary:
MIT researchers show that OpenAI's GPT-6 Astra can read and deliberately rewrite the weights of other AI models without traditional training. In one experiment, Astra boosted a Qwen model's math accuracy from 7.9 to 48.1 percent by changing just 0.016 percent of its weights. The approach could fundamentally simplify AI optimization but still hits clear limits.

en.summary: The author's notes distill Kuaishou's enterprise AI deployment experience into a practical playbook: first codify employee expertise into shared capabilities, then restructure how work is divided; use small teams to shorten delivery chains, pair that with an intelligent QA system that grades requirements by risk, and build a unified foundation plus a credit/points mechanism to control costs. Anthropic 推出开源漏洞扫描服务 OSS Scanner，利用 Claude Mythos 等前沿模型自动生成含复现步骤、缺陷定位与候选补丁的安全报告，绕过人工审核瓶颈。
支持二分法定位引入缺陷的提交；每份报告附独立复现程序与可选修复补丁；已向 PostgreSQL 等项目提供快速通道并前置修复问题。
适合开源项目维护者、安全工程师、SRE 与 DevSecOps 工程师阅读。
AI 公司 Anthropic 推出 OSS Scanner ，这是一项免费、可选择加入的服务，用于发现开源项目中的漏洞。 已注册的维护者会收到由该公司最强模型（包括 Claude Mythos）生成的定期安全报告 。报告未经人工审核直接发送，项目维护者可自行验证扫描结果，并决定采纳哪些修复方案。

en.title: Anthropic adds optional security scanning service for critical open source projects
en.summary:
Anthropic launches OSS Scanner, a free, opt-in open source vulnerability scanning tool.

Anthropic launches OSS Scanner, a free, opt-in open source vulnerability scanning tool.
Word count: 1,875 | About 6 minutes to read

Anthropic has launched OSS Scanner, an open source vulnerability scanning service that uses frontier models such as Claude Mythos to automatically generate security reports with reproduction steps, defect localization and candidate patches, bypassing the manual review bottleneck.

It supports bisection to identify the commit that introduced a defect; each report includes a standalone reproduction program and an optional fix patch; projects such as PostgreSQL have been given a fast track, with fixes pushed upstream in advance.

Intended for open source maintainers, security engineers, SREs and DevSecOps engineers.

AI company Anthropic has launched OSS Scanner, a free, opt-in service for finding vulnerabilities in open source projects. Registered maintainers receive periodic security reports generated by the company's most capable models, including Claude Mythos. The reports are sent without human review; maintainers can verify the findings themselves and decide which fixes to adopt.

en.title: Harbor adds Docker Sandboxes support for running reproducible AI agent evaluations in isolated MicroVMs
en.summary: Docker announced that its open-source agent evaluation framework Harbor now supports Docker Sandboxes, allowing each evaluation task to run in its own microVM. The addition lets coding agent evaluations run in isolated microVMs, balancing security and reproducibility. Docker has completed cloud validation with 64 concurrent tasks and frames the evaluation use case as running untrusted AI code at scale. Harbor provides microVM-level isolation to prevent reward hacking and other out-of-bounds behavior, staged network policy controls to keep evaluation environments consistent, and Docker Compose support for multi-container collaborative evaluation. It is aimed at AI coding agent researchers, MLOps engineers, and security sandbox architects.
en.reason: Harbor now runs each coding-agent evaluation task inside its own Docker Sandboxes microVM, and Docker has validated 64 concurrent tasks in the cloud while defining evaluation as running untrusted AI code at scale.

en.title: Study: AI-generated code hits downstream bottlenecks and fails to boost overall productivity
en.summary:
A study of 718 companies by Harvard University and the Jellyfish platform found that while AI coding assistants and agents increase code volume, bottlenecks downstream—such as code review—prevent a corresponding rise in effective completed work.

A Harvard University study of 718 companies, conducted with the Jellyfish analytics platform, found that while AI coding assistants and agents can boost code output, this does not translate into a matching increase in completed work, partly because AI-generated code adds to later-stage development work, especially code review.

Word count: 1,209 words
Reading time: about 4 minutes

AI coding assistants deliver only limited and statistically insignificant gains in code output; AI agents significantly improve coding metrics, but the increase in delivered results (+12% tickets resolved) falls far short of the increase in code volume (+30% lines), reflecting higher downstream review and integration costs.

For AI coding assistants, only commit activity showed a statistically significant increase; AI agents significantly improved all three coding metrics; higher code output did not translate linearly into higher delivery efficiency.

Intended for engineering leaders, engineering productivity engineers, and AI tool platform developers.

A recent Harvard University study of 718 companies, using the Jellyfish analytics platform, found that although AI coding assistants and agents can increase code output, this does not translate into a corresponding growth in completed work—partly because AI-generated code increases late-stage development work, particularly code review.

en.reason: Harvard and Jellyfish's survey of 718 firms finds AI agents raise code volume 30% but Jira ticket resolutions only 12%, with review time up 49% and comments up 53%, shifting the bottleneck downstream.

en.summary:

On October 21, OpenClaw founder Peter Steinberger estimated on stage at Cloudflare Connect that his token spend on AI work last month came to roughly $10 million. The audience gasped. He added: "Not all of that usage was useful."

en.title: Can Codex build a Linux kernel? It wrote a new 139,000-line kernel in 11 days—and Rocky Linux 10 boots on it.
en.summary:
Can’t write an OS even with unlimited tokens? Rocky Linux founder builds a new kernel with Codex in 11 days
Gregory Kurtzer, a CentOS co-founder and the founder of Rocky Linux, announced on X on October 27, 2026 that he used human-directed agentic engineering (HDAE) to write about 139,000 lines of code in 11 days for a new Linux-compatible kernel that can boot Rocky Linux 10 and run systemd. The project is called Ginux.
en.reason: Rocky Linux founder Gregory Kurtzer used Codex to write Ginux, a roughly 139,000-line Rust-heavy Linux-compatible kernel, in 11 days, booting Rocky Linux 10 with systemd at about $8,000 in API costs.

智能商品推荐助手 是一款基于前沿生成式 AI 技术构建的下一代电商导购平台。
系统通过对话式交互（Conversational UI），深度理解用户模糊、复杂的购物意图，结合私有商品知识库（RAG）和实时业务数据（MCP/Function Calling），提供精准的商品推荐、比价分析，并支持下单、退货、评价、取消订单等一站式交易闭环。
系统采用 RAG（检索增强生成）+ Function Calling（工具调用）+ MCP + Graph 工作流的组合架构：
这是系统的大脑，负责编排整个对话流程。
用于解决 LLM 的幻觉问题和知识滞后问题。
赋予 AI "手" 和 "眼"。
本系统将交易操作封装为 AI 可调用

en.title: Conversational shopping assistant + RAG + MCP: an intelligent product recommendation system
en.summary:
Introduction

| Dimension | Description |
| Tech stack | Spring AI (Alibaba) + RAG (Milvus / PgVector) + Function Calling + MCP + Graph workflows + SSE streaming |

One-line positioning: a conversational e-commerce shopping guide AI Agent that can chat, recommend products, and actually place orders.

Why it's worth putting on your resume
More hands-on projects at Java Commando: susan.net.cn/project

Smart Product Recommendation Assistant is a next-generation e-commerce shopping guide platform built on cutting-edge generative AI technology.

Through a conversational UI, the system deeply understands users' vague, complex shopping intents. It combines a private product knowledge base (RAG) with real-time business data (MCP/Function Calling) to deliver precise product recommendations and price comparison analysis, and supports a one-stop transaction loop covering ordering, returns, reviews, and order cancellation.

The system uses a combined architecture of RAG (Retrieval-Augmented Generation) + Function Calling + MCP + Graph workflows:

This is the system's brain, responsible for orchestrating the entire conversation flow.

It solves the LLM's hallucination and knowledge-lag problems.

It gives the AI "hands" and "eyes."

The system wraps transaction operations as AI-callable
en.reason: A conversational e-commerce shopping-guide AI Agent built with Spring AI (Alibaba), RAG over Milvus/PgVector, Function Calling, MCP and Graph workflow handles fuzzy shopping intents, recommendations, price comparison and an order, return, review and cancellation transaction loop.

items.recommend_reason_zh: 这本紧凑的推导式入门书把 PCA、diffusion models 与 GANs 等生成模型串成一条数学主线，帮助研究者理解这些模型如何推导、彼此关联，适合想打牢基础的人。

en.title: Anthropic adds optional security scanning service for critical open source projects
en.summary:
Anthropic launches OSS Scanner, a free, opt-in open source vulnerability scanning tool.

Anthropic launches OSS Scanner, a free, opt-in open source vulnerability scanning tool.
Word count: 1,875 | About 6 minutes to read

Anthropic has launched OSS Scanner, an open source vulnerability scanning service that uses frontier models such as Claude Mythos to automatically generate security reports with reproduction steps, defect localization and candidate patches, bypassing the manual review bottleneck.

It supports bisection to identify the commit that introduced a defect; each report includes a standalone reproduction program and an optional fix patch; projects such as PostgreSQL have been given a fast track, with fixes pushed upstream in advance.

Intended for open source maintainers, security engineers, SREs and DevSecOps engineers.

AI company Anthropic has launched OSS Scanner, a free, opt-in service for finding vulnerabilities in open source projects. Registered maintainers receive periodic security reports generated by the company's most capable models, including Claude Mythos. The reports are sent without human review; maintainers can verify the findings themselves and decide which fixes to adopt.

en.title: Harbor adds Docker Sandboxes support for running reproducible AI agent evaluations in isolated MicroVMs
en.summary: Docker announced that its open-source agent evaluation framework Harbor now supports Docker Sandboxes, allowing each evaluation task to run in its own microVM. The addition lets coding agent evaluations run in isolated microVMs, balancing security and reproducibility. Docker has completed cloud validation with 64 concurrent tasks and frames the evaluation use case as running untrusted AI code at scale. Harbor provides microVM-level isolation to prevent reward hacking and other out-of-bounds behavior, staged network policy controls to keep evaluation environments consistent, and Docker Compose support for multi-container collaborative evaluation. It is aimed at AI coding agent researchers, MLOps engineers, and security sandbox architects.
en.reason: Harbor now runs each coding-agent evaluation task inside its own Docker Sandboxes microVM, and Docker has validated 64 concurrent tasks in the cloud while defining evaluation as running untrusted AI code at scale.

en.title: Study: AI-generated code hits downstream bottlenecks and fails to boost overall productivity
en.summary:
A study of 718 companies by Harvard University and the Jellyfish platform found that while AI coding assistants and agents increase code volume, bottlenecks downstream—such as code review—prevent a corresponding rise in effective completed work.

A Harvard University study of 718 companies, conducted with the Jellyfish analytics platform, found that while AI coding assistants and agents can boost code output, this does not translate into a matching increase in completed work, partly because AI-generated code adds to later-stage development work, especially code review.

Word count: 1,209 words
Reading time: about 4 minutes

AI coding assistants deliver only limited and statistically insignificant gains in code output; AI agents significantly improve coding metrics, but the increase in delivered results (+12% tickets resolved) falls far short of the increase in code volume (+30% lines), reflecting higher downstream review and integration costs.

For AI coding assistants, only commit activity showed a statistically significant increase; AI agents significantly improved all three coding metrics; higher code output did not translate linearly into higher delivery efficiency.

Intended for engineering leaders, engineering productivity engineers, and AI tool platform developers.

A recent Harvard University study of 718 companies, using the Jellyfish analytics platform, found that although AI coding assistants and agents can increase code output, this does not translate into a corresponding growth in completed work—partly because AI-generated code increases late-stage development work, particularly code review.

en.title: Conversational shopping assistant + RAG + MCP: an intelligent product recommendation system
en.summary:
Introduction

| Dimension | Description |
| Tech stack | Spring AI (Alibaba) + RAG (Milvus / PgVector) + Function Calling + MCP + Graph workflows + SSE streaming |

One-line positioning: a conversational e-commerce shopping guide AI Agent that can chat, recommend products, and actually place orders.

Why it's worth putting on your resume
More hands-on projects at Java Commando: susan.net.cn/project

Smart Product Recommendation Assistant is a next-generation e-commerce shopping guide platform built on cutting-edge generative AI technology.

Through a conversational UI, the system deeply understands users' vague, complex shopping intents. It combines a private product knowledge base (RAG) with real-time business data (MCP/Function Calling) to deliver precise product recommendations and price comparison analysis, and supports a one-stop transaction loop covering ordering, returns, reviews, and order cancellation.

The system uses a combined architecture of RAG (Retrieval-Augmented Generation) + Function Calling + MCP + Graph workflows:

This is the system's brain, responsible for orchestrating the entire conversation flow.

It solves the LLM's hallucination and knowledge-lag problems.

It gives the AI "hands" and "eyes."

The system wraps transaction operations as AI-callable
en.reason: A conversational e-commerce shopping-guide AI Agent built with Spring AI (Alibaba), RAG over Milvus/PgVector, Function Calling, MCP and Graph workflow handles fuzzy shopping intents, recommendations, price comparison and an order, return, review and cancellation transaction loop.
